tagline: Task and project lookups for remote teammates — task changes need your approval.
requirements: Set TODOIST_API_KEY in the host environment, using an app-specific token. This is the official local server; it registers many more tools than documented here, and everything outside the allowlist requires explicit approval.

tools.name: user-info
tools.note: Identifies the account behind the API key.

tools.name: get-overview
tools.note: Summarizes projects, sections, and open tasks.

tools.name: fetch
tools.note: Fetches a task or project by ID (OpenAI-compatible interface).

tools.name: update-tasks
tools.note: Updates task content, dates, and priorities.

tools.name: delete-object
tools.note: Deletes tasks, projects, sections, comments, or labels.

seo.description: Share the official Todoist MCP server with MCPWire. Configure an API key on the host, let teammates read tasks and projects over P2P, and keep task writes behind approval.
